# CYBERCORE UI glyphs

13 outline SVGs from revision `5b90ffbcc4a1aa84d122eead296fab0cf7ee58ca` of [CYBERCORE CSS](https://github.com/sebyx07/cybercore-css). MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 sebyx07. Preserve `LICENSE` and the in-APK notice.

The extracted outline SVGs are retained in `source/`. Circle, line, polygon and rectangle geometry is expressed as native VectorDrawable paths. Stroke width, caps and joins are preserved; `currentColor` is tintable white. `assets.json` records the source definition and generated vector hash. No CSS or JavaScript runtime is bundled. Other Cyberpunk HUD drawing and motion code is original Vitreo code.
